sentences.text:
This is the repeat (second) bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS/439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.173/2024 registered at Police Station,
Bhalumada, District Anuppur (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376, 376A, 376, 506 of IPC and Section 3,4 of POCSO Act.
First application was dismissed as withdrawn.

2. As per the prosecution story, allegation against the applicant is that he committed rape with the minor prosecutrix therefore, the aforesaid offence has been registered against him.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has falsely been implicated in the present case.
The applicant is in jail since 09.04.2024.
Charge sheet has been filed and trial will take considerable time to conclude.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.

4. Learned counsel for the State has vehemently opposed the grant of NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:21931 2 MCRC-5917-2025 bail to the applicant and submitted that prosecutrix is minor.
In her Court statement, she has deposed against the present applicant.
Hence, he prayed for rejection of this bail application.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6.
Looking to the overall facts and circumstances of the case as well as seriousness of offence, I am not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
